description: Reads one LiveDoc section at the requested revision and returns `{partId, headingPath, markdown, truncated}`. Requires a project ID, space ID, and document name readable by the signed-in Polarion user; select the section with its part ID or exact heading path. Use `read_document_markdown` for the full body or `get_document_outline` to discover headings and IDs first.

document.description: LiveDoc name within the space, not a composite project/space/document path.

heading_path.description: Exact heading path as an array of titles or a string joined with ` > `; use the outline to copy it.

items.description: One heading title in the path, from the outermost heading to the target.

max_chars.description: Maximum returned Markdown characters; defaults to 20000 and is capped at 100000.

part_id.description: Exact LiveDoc part ID from `get_document_outline`; identifies the section heading.

projectId.description: Polarion project ID that owns the LiveDoc, such as `PROJECT`.

revision.description: Repository revision to read; omit to use the current revision.

spaceId.description: Document space ID within the project, such as `Specifications`.

name: read_document_section
title: Read LiveDoc section
